notes.title: Holiday update!
notes.content:
Hey there everyone,

It has been a super long time since I have posted an update for the game. Like most people, 2020 has taken a toll on me. I had some personal issues for a good portion of the year, and I didn't feel very creative at all.

However, I think things are ironed out and I have been working very much on the game. Just polishing, adding levels, adding equipment and moves for the player to do, and just overall making a better game than I ever would have if I had rushed it.

I will have more detailed update soon with more real info, but I wanted people to know I am am still here and working on a very neat (in my opinion) little game. I am excited for people to try it. 

Thanks for the support, and I will talk to you all again soon. 

Thanks,

notes.title: May Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37455057/ba2bde83155b9d389485c595602d0bac7333014b.png[/img]

Hey all!

Man, this has been a busy month. After launching the Steam page for the game, I got an email about the Steam Summer Festival and I decided to make a demo for it! This caused a change of direction. I was sort of forced to to build a vertical slice style demo of what the game had done. Not a big deal, but this included a [i]lotttt[/i] of playtesting and refinement. I crunched to get it done, but I am really glad I did! The demo is in the review queue and should be live soon!

Here is a list of some of the changes made, additions, and refinements: 
[list]
[*] Added a boss battle with [i]Drasorin[/i]
[*] Added a new set of levels leading up to the boss battle
[*] Added a Return to Town option on the world menu
[*] Refined the Status menu
[*] Countless bug fixes and QoL updates
[*] New enemy types
[*] SFX and BGM level options
[*] Menu animations
[/list]

There are so many more that could be listed. This really looks like a new game! I can't wait for the demo to be live so you guys can try it out.

[h2]Going Forward[/h2]

So, the next couple of month is going to be building the world out more, playtesting, building boss fights, and fleshing out the story part of the game! I have a lot of NPC and Shopkeeper dialogue written. Can't wait to get that added! :D

I will post an update when the Demo is live. Should be soon!

Thank you for your continued support.

 ~Kei

notes.title: April Update
notes.content:
Hey all!

This is my first community post for [i]Fantasy Story[/i]! What a crazy month! The apocalypse is going on outside, but thankfully I have stayed in and got to work on the game! It is super exciting to have a store presence now! I have gotten traffic from all over the world and that is so awesome!

I would sort of like to talk about what I am currently working on!

[h1]On Deck Currently[/h1]

So, right now my biggest priority is to get a demo ready for the Steam Summer Festival. This involves designing a boss battle, updating UI, designing rooms, and playtesting! Overall, it is something I would really love to get the game into. It would bring new fans in and let me get the game out there! Here is a WIP sprite of the boss I am working on. 

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37455057/337002ea3dbe9682ac1555156d21c0c4631cf03d.gif][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37455057/337002ea3dbe9682ac1555156d21c0c4631cf03d.gif[/img][/url]

I am going to add in some options menu stuff as well. A lot of this needed to be done anyways, but I had planned on doing more of my polish stuff later on. Crazy how things work out! Here are a couple of things I would like to add:

[list]
[*] Tabs or arrows to indicate what menu tab you're in.
[*] Sound level options
[*] General refinements and bugfixes 
[/list]

This is going to be a stressful month, but I feel like in the end it will be worth it. I can't wait for you guys to get to play the game. :)

Until next time,

~Kei
